mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (total, status, created_at) VALUES (#{total}, #{status}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT orders.id, orders.status, order_item.product_id from orders INNER JOIN order_item ON orders.id = order_item.order_id where orders.id = (#{id})
SELECT id as orderid, total as total, created_at as ordercreated, status as orderStatus FROM orders WHERE id = #{orderId}

SELECT oi.product_id as productId, p.name as productName, oi.price as price, oi.quantity, (oi.price * oi.quantity) as totalPrice FROM order_item oi LEFT JOIN product p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId}
